hook.text: Full after a big lunch, you promise to eat healthy all week. By dinner, you are starving and the promise dissolves.

buildup.text: The empathy gap means people in one emotional state cannot accurately predict how they will feel or behave.

discovery.text: George Loewenstein identified this in 1996. When calm, we underestimate the power of anger.

twist.text: The gap works both ways. Hungry people overestimate how long hunger will last. Sad people believe sadness is permanent.

climax.text: Never make commitments in a state you will not be in when you must honor them.

punchline.text: Plan for your worst state, not your best mood.

quiz.question: What is the empathy gap?
options: Inability to feel any empathy at all
Failure to predict behavior in different emotional states
A gap between empathy and sympathy
